name: Bulk Global Carrier Lookup
description: Turn a phone list into routing-ready context. Append carrier, underlying carrier, line type, country, region and city to international records, then use the enriched result for routing, regional analysis, segmentation and CRM updates.

result_fields.name: number
result_fields.description: The original submitted E.164 number, used to match carrier and geographic results back to the original list record.

result_fields.name: carrier
result_fields.description: The customer-facing carrier name when identifiable. Use it for service routing or CRM enrichment; do not infer that no carrier exists when the value is empty.

result_fields.name: underlying_carrier
result_fields.description: The underlying network-carrier information when identifiable. It can differ from carrier for resellers, virtual operators or ported numbers.

result_fields.name: number_type
result_fields.description: The returned line type, such as mobile, fixed line or another identifiable category. It can support routing and segmentation when used with your own business rules.

result_fields.name: country_code
result_fields.description: The returned country or territory code for baseline grouping and regional reporting across international lists. It is not a person’s current location.

result_fields.name: region
result_fields.description: The returned region or state/province context when available. It supports regional analysis and should not be treated as an exact geographic location.

result_fields.name: city
result_fields.description: The returned city-level context when available. Data sources and number allocation can affect accuracy, so validate it against your own address or consent records when needed.
